items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and I said get Kenny [indiscernible], so Kenny [indiscernible] came with the group, you know.

ctx.x: 1950-something. 1956 or something. And Lalo Shiftman [phonetic sp.] was the piano player. Rudy Collins [phonetic sp.] the drummer, and Chris White [phonetic sp.] was [indiscernible]. Then Lalo left and -- and Dizzy asked -- and I said get Kenny [indiscernible], so Kenny [indiscernible] came with the group, you know. And then, when Kenny left, then Mike came with the group. Mike Longwell [phonetic sp.], you know. So.
